title: any non chibi sideview battlers for free?

posts.author: hyanmaru
posts.body:
Hello, I need some sideview battlers that go beyond the rpg maker mz base human battlers because they're *too much* small and chibi, while I'm planning for something somewhat realistic.
But before even starting considering making them myself, I want to be sure it fits the screen in the way I want and make sure I like the side-view battle. So I'd rather try something similiar to my idea and, once I made sure I like sideview battlers with adult proportions, then commissioning to some artist.
Anyone has at least *1* free battler spritesheet that isn't Sonic, Megaman or Mario?
thank you in advance

posts.author: Holder
posts.body: I have a growing collection of free resources which contain bases as well as pre made actors and enemies. All links are in my signature.
